title: Birthday Bot
description: Because we all need a little help remembering. Allows you to set your birthday, and it can notify everyone in your server on your special day!
footer:
This bot ignores weird old date rules and works off of UTC time.
If you have a problem with that, I refer you to this:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-5wpm-gesOY

entries.description: Shows all birthdays for this server.
Shows the next birthday for this server.

Sets your birthday to the given date. It is remembered across all servers. Year is not required, but it is necessary for age-based messages.

Acceptable date formats include (but not limited to):
February 29
Feb 29, 2000
2/29/00
2-29-2000
Removes your birthday from the bot.

Uses this channel to announce birthdays.
If you disabled notifications, use this command to bring it back.
NO ANNOUNCEMENTS WILL BE MADE UNTIL THIS IS DONE.
Sets the UTC 24hr time for announcing birthdays. Defaults to 12:00 UTC
Sets the prefix for all commands. Must be between 1-3 characters. Default is "!"
Disables birthday notifications for this server.
